title: glandularia dissecta
intro: Glandularia dissecta, commonly known as Rosita or Butterfly Plant, is a flowering plant species native to the Andes mountains in South America. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include promoting digestive health, reducing inflammation, and soothing respiratory issues. The health benefits of Glandularia dissecta are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
